findings.behavior: Select marked pages with granule strictly less than target. A selected page may end in a non-audio packet; page landmarks are not limited to accepted audio.
Start synthesis from the selected queued packet, skip non-audio packets, and reconstruct overlap only from accepted packets after that anchor.

findings.reason_from_source: Page anchor falls on the inserted non-audio packet at granule zero. The last accepted audio packet becomes the first overlap-priming packet after restart and emits no PCM.

findings.behavior: Track-only skipping trusts marked granules; subsequent PCM discard stops when pcm_offset reaches or exceeds the target. Trace these transitions and the fetch-path granule adjustment for the broadcast-offset overshoot cases; their exact cause remains to be validated.
